doc: Audit table of JSON key-paths observed in adapter fixtures and what the corpus projection does with each. Path notation: dotted keys, '[]' marks an array step. Destination categories: 'projected:<column>' = lands in a typed column; 'preserved:<column>' = derived from this path into the column but the raw bytes also survive in entries.raw_json; 'raw_only:<reason>' = only in entries.raw_json (intentional v1 design or accepted gap). Adding a new fixture path that is not in this table fails TestKeyPathCoverage; the fix is to make the deliberate choice and record it here.

paths.message.content[].name: projected:messages.tool_name (tool_use)
paths.message.content[].input.file_path: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].input.pattern: raw_only:reachable via messages.files_json blob, not a typed column
paths.message.content[].id: raw_only:tool_use id, not projected in v1
paths.message.content[].tool_use_id: raw_only:tool_result link, intentional v1: tool_result bodies are not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.content[].content: raw_only:tool_result body, intentional v1: not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.content[].is_error: raw_only:tool_result error flag, intentional v1: not indexed (parser.go:121)
paths.message.usage.cache_creation_input_token: projected:messages.tokens (summed; cache-write split discarded — see cross-agent-data-capture.md)
paths.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens: projected:messages.tokens (summed; cache-read split discarded — see cross-agent-data-capture.md)
paths.firstKeptEntryId: raw_only:Pi compaction node — future column compaction_first_kept_entry_id (cross-agent-data-capture.md priority 3)
paths.tokensBefore: raw_only:Pi compaction node — future column compaction_tokens_before (cross-agent-data-capture.md priority 3)
paths.fromId: raw_only:Pi branch_summary points to alternate-branch start — future column branch_from_entry_id
